newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 29.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- In spite of sluggish consumer spending, which dropped by 2.9 percent in June, a rise in the dollar against the franc is providing the government with a favourable economic context for export-led growth.
-- Analysts see improving outlook for car manufacturers Renault and PSA Peugeot Citroen, due notably to favourable foreign exchange movements and improving market outlook.
-- Air France chairman Christian Blanc presented to Socialist Prime Minister Lionel Jospin yesterday a preliminary assessment of the airline's situation and outlook ahead of a possible privatisation.
-- Jospin confirms defence budget will not to be excluded from efforts towards controlling public spending for 1998.
